answer_contract: The repository does not currently prove an exact number of strategies developed by NeuroVest. NeuroVest has 173 normalized strategy entries in its research library. Eight strategies have repeated candidate-specific or small-set lifecycle evidence. Five of those eight also have strong structured model lineage. The five are a subset of the eight, so 8 + 5 must never be presented as 13 distinct strategies. Lifecycle evidence and model lineage do not by themselves prove that a strategy was developed, trained, qualified, refined, or promoted by NeuroVest.
claim_boundaries: Research-library membership does not prove that a strategy was developed by NeuroVest.
Research-library membership does not prove that a strategy was trained.
Research-library membership does not prove that a strategy was qualified.
Research-library membership does not prove that a strategy was refined by NeuroVest.
Research-library membership does not prove that a strategy was promoted.
Repeated candidate-specific or small-set lifecycle evidence is lineage evidence, not proof that NeuroVest developed, trained, qualified, refined, or promoted that strategy.
Structured model lineage proves model-lineage relevance, not proof that NeuroVest developed, trained, qualified, refined, or promoted that strategy.
The five structured-model-lineage strategies are contained within the eight repeated-lifecycle-evidence strategies.
The counts 8 and 5 overlap and are not additive.
Never infer or state that NeuroVest developed 13 strategies from the counts 8 and 5.
When asked how many strategies NeuroVest developed, state that the exact developed count is not proven by the current repository evidence.
